use source_layout

record Definition

record Unit
file:t source:t

record View
offset:i header:b include:b found:*t source:t

record Bundle
files:*{Unit} found:*t

record Packet
observation:t files:*{Unit}

contains_name names:*t target:t > b
fold names false hit row name or hit text_eq name target

enqueue names:*t target:t > *t
if contains_name names target names append names target

callees graph:*{Definition} target:t > *t
let edges fold graph (nil *t) result row node
  if text_eq (get name node) target (some get calls node) result
need edges "definition_missing_from_graph" 0

reachable graph:*{Definition} root:t > *t
let queue fold graph (list t 1 root) names row unused
  case (at names (- row 1)) names target
  fold (callees graph target) names acc index child enqueue acc child
if > length queue length graph fail "incomplete_graph" queue

record ApiSignature
name:t kind:t signature:t

unused_signatures signatures:*{ApiSignature} reachable_names:*t > *t
fold signatures (list t 0) acc row entry
  if (and (text_eq (get kind entry) "function") (not (contains_name reachable_names (get name entry))))
     (append acc (get signature entry)) acc

selected_name header:t wanted:*t > ?t
let signature if (function_header header "rule")
  (text_slice header (+ 4 (need (text_find header "rule" 0) "invalid_header" 0)) (text_len header)) header
fold wanted (nil t) previous row name
  case previous (if function_header signature name (some name) (nil t)) match_name previous

visit_line text:t wanted:*t view:{View} line:t > {View}
if (case (text_find line "\r" 0) false idx true) fail "expected_lf_or_crlf"
let start get offset view
let stop + start text_len line
let next if eq stop (text_len text) stop (+ stop (if text_eq (text_slice text stop (+ stop 2)) "\r\n" 2 1))
let blank indent_only line
let header and (get header view) (not blank)
let name if header (selected_name line wanted) (nil t)
let include if blank false
  if header (case name (or (function_header line "record") (function_header line "variant")) selected true)
  get include view
let found case name (get found view) selected
  if (contains_name (get found view) selected) fail "duplicate_definition_source" (append (get found view) selected)
let output get source view
let separator if (and header (> (text_len output) 0)) "\n" ""
make View offset next header blank include include found found
  source (if include (concat output (concat separator (text_slice text start next))) output)

collect_file bundle:{Bundle} unit:{Unit} wanted:*t > {Bundle}
let text get source unit
if other_line_ending text fail "expected_lf_or_crlf"
let initial make View offset 0 header true include false found (get found bundle) source ""
let view fold (lines text) initial acc row line visit_line text wanted acc line
let excerpt get source view
make Bundle files (if text_eq excerpt "" (get files bundle)
  (append (get files bundle) (with source unit excerpt))) found (get found view)

main root:t observation:t graph:*{Definition} units:*{Unit} > {Packet}
let wanted reachable graph root
let bundle fold units (make Bundle files (list {Unit} 0) found (list t 0)) acc row unit collect_file acc unit wanted
if not eq (length get found bundle) (length wanted) fail "definition_missing_from_source"
make Packet observation observation files (get files bundle)

record Buffer
body:t caret:i goal:i clip:t eol:t dirty:b mode:{Mode} notice:t

record View
body:t caret:i title:t status:t help:t

main body:t > {Buffer}
let eol case (text_find body "\n" 0) "\n" lf
    if text_eq (text_slice body (- lf 1) lf) "\r" "\r\n" "\n"
make Buffer body body caret 0 goal -1 clip "" eol eol dirty false mode (tag Mode writing) notice ""

line_begin body:t pos:i > i
case (text_rfind body "\n" pos) 0 lf (+ lf 1)

line_limit body:t pos:i > i
case (text_find body "\n" pos) (text_len body) lf
if text_eq (text_slice body (- lf 1) lf) "\r" (- lf 1) lf

previous_pos body:t pos:i > i
if < pos 1 0
if text_eq (text_slice body (- pos 2) pos) "\r\n" (- pos 2) (- pos 1)

next_pos body:t pos:i > i
if eq pos (text_len body) pos
if text_eq (text_slice body pos (+ pos 2)) "\r\n" (+ pos 2) (+ pos 1)

moved world:{Buffer} dest:i goal:i > {Buffer}
make Buffer body (get body world) caret dest goal goal clip (get clip world) eol (get eol world)
dirty (get dirty world) mode (tag Mode writing) notice ""

vertical world:{Buffer} upwards:b > {Buffer}
let body get body world
let pos get caret world
let begin line_begin body pos
let limit line_limit body pos
let goal if < get goal world 0 (- pos begin) get goal world
if or (and upwards eq begin 0) (and not upwards eq limit text_len body) world
let row if upwards (previous_pos body begin) (next_pos body limit)
let target + (line_begin body row) goal
let last line_limit body row
moved world (if > target last last target) goal

splice world:{Buffer} lo:i hi:i value:t clip:t > {Buffer}
if and eq lo hi text_eq value "" world
let body get body world
let result concat (text_slice body 0 lo) (concat value (text_slice body hi (text_len body)))
make Buffer body result caret (+ lo text_len value) goal -1 clip clip eol (get eol world)
dirty true mode (tag Mode writing) notice ""

insert_text world:{Buffer} value:t > {Buffer}
splice world (get caret world) (get caret world) value (get clip world)

cut_line world:{Buffer} > {Buffer}
let body get body world
let pos get caret world
let lo line_begin body pos
let hi next_pos body (line_limit body pos)
splice world lo hi "" (text_slice body lo hi)

stay world:{Buffer} > &{Buffer}{Effect}
pair world (tag Effect idle)

shortcut world:{Buffer} value:t > &{Buffer}{Effect}
if text_eq value "o" (pair world (tag Effect store))
if text_eq value "x"
   (if get dirty world (stay with mode world (tag Mode confirm_exit)) (pair world (tag Effect finish)))
if text_eq value "k" (stay cut_line world)
if text_eq value "u" (stay insert_text world get clip world)
stay world

edit_key world:{Buffer} key:{Input} value:t > &{Buffer}{Effect}
let body get body world
let pos get caret world
match key
character  stay insert_text world value
enter_key  stay insert_text world get eol world
backspace  stay splice world (previous_pos body pos) pos "" (get clip world)
delete_key stay splice world pos (next_pos body pos) "" (get clip world)
left       stay moved world (previous_pos body pos) -1
right      stay moved world (next_pos body pos) -1
home_key   stay moved world (line_begin body pos) -1
end_key    stay moved world (line_limit body pos) -1
up         stay vertical world true
down       stay vertical world false
control    shortcut world value
escape     stay world
stored     stay with notice (with dirty world false) "Gespeichert"
io_error   stay with notice world value
end

confirm_key world:{Buffer} key:{Input} value:t > &{Buffer}{Effect}
match key
character  if or (or text_eq value "j" text_eq value "J") (or text_eq value "y" text_eq value "Y")
           (pair world (tag Effect store))
           if or text_eq value "n" text_eq value "N" (pair world (tag Effect finish)) (stay world)
control    if text_eq value "c" (stay with mode world (tag Mode writing)) (stay world)
escape     stay with mode world (tag Mode writing)
stored     pair world (tag Effect finish)
io_error   stay with notice (with mode world (tag Mode writing)) value
left       stay world
right      stay world
up         stay world
down       stay world
home_key   stay world
end_key    stay world
backspace  stay world
delete_key stay world
enter_key  stay world
end

step world:{Buffer} key:{Input} value:t > &{Buffer}{Effect}
match get mode world
writing      edit_key world key value
confirm_exit confirm_key world key value
end

view world:{Buffer} name:t > {View}
let title concat "TIDE nano  " (concat name (if get dirty world "  *" ""))
let prompt match get mode world
  writing get notice world
  confirm_exit "Vor dem Beenden speichern?  J Ja   N Verwerfen   Esc Abbrechen"
end
make View body (get body world) caret (get caret world) title title status prompt
help "^O Speichern   ^X Beenden   ^K Zeile ausschneiden   ^U Einsetzen"

done < <(jq -r '.units[].file' "$w/input")

while IFS=$'\t' read -r name file line column; do

    jq -ce --arg rev "$rev" --arg file "$file" 'if .revision==$rev then {name:.definition,$file,body:.selection.expanded} else error("project revision changed") end'
done | jq -sc . > "$w/forms"
view=$(jq -c --slurpfile forms "$w/forms" '.+{forms:$forms[0]}' "$w/packet")

stamp > "$w/end"

commands.special:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
w=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
repo=$PWD
for caseid in nano invaders rule layout; do
  case "$caseid" in
    nano) entry="$repo/apps/nano.tide"; root=step;;
    invaders) entry="$repo/apps/space_invaders.tide"; root=draw;;
    rule) entry="$repo/apps/heat.tide"; root=heat_ready;;
    layout) entry="$w/layout/main name.tide"; root=main;;
  esac
  a="$w/special-$caseid-old"; b="$w/special-$caseid-new"
  mkdir "$a" "$b"
  rc=0; "$w/timed-old" "$a" "$entry" "$root" check 2> "$a/errors" || rc=$?
  "$w/timed-new" "$b" "$entry" "$root" check
  cmp <(jq -Sc . "$a/forms") <(jq -Sc . "$b/forms")
  if [[ $rc != 0 ]]; then
    jq -e '.code=="E_LIMIT"' "$a/errors" >/dev/null
    cp "$a/packet" "$a/partial"; jq -c '.[]' "$a/forms" |
    while IFS= read -r form; do
      p=$(jq -c --argjson form "$form" '{observation,files,forms:[$form]}' "$a/partial")
      "$repo/tide" run "$w/legacy/workbench/function_body.tide" --call repair_view --inputs "$p" > "$a/next"
      mv "$a/next" "$a/partial"
    done
    cmp <(jq -Sc . "$a/partial") <(jq -Sc . "$b/grouped")
  else
    cmp <(jq -Sc . "$a/grouped") <(jq -Sc . "$b/grouped")
  fi
  p=$(jq -nc --slurpfile i "$b/input" --slurpfile forms "$b/forms" '{observation:"",files:$i[0].units,forms:$forms[0]}')
  "$repo/tide" run "$repo/workbench/grouped_view.tide" --call compiler_view --inputs "$p" > "$b/full"
  mkdir "$b/recompiled"
  while IFS= read -r file; do jq -ejr --arg file "$file" '.files[]|select(.file==$file)|.source' "$b/full" > "$b/recompiled/$file"; done < <(jq -r '.files[].file' "$b/full")
  base=$(basename -- "$entry")
  "$repo/tide" test "$entry" > "$b/before-tests"
  "$repo/tide" test "$b/recompiled/$base" > "$b/after-tests"
  cmp "$b/before-tests" "$b/after-tests"
  if [[ $caseid == layout ]]; then
    v=$("$repo/tide" run "$entry" --inputs '{"n":4}')
    [[ $v == 9 && $("$repo/tide" run "$b/recompiled/$base" --inputs '{"n":4}') == 9 ]]
  fi
  jq -nc --arg id "$caseid" --arg root "$root" --slurpfile plan "$b/plan" --slurpfile tests "$b/after-tests" --slurpfile diag "$a/errors" --argjson rc "$rc" '{project:$id,root:$root,old_exit:$rc,old_diagnostic:$diag[0],new_matches_reference:true,forms:($plan[0].queries|length),two_calls:([$plan[0].queries[]|select(.column==0)]|length),recompiled_tests:$tests[0]}' >> "$w/special.ndjson"
done
